title: Pearl Fix
description: This Fix adds extended momentum, accuracy for each pearl throw, and better pathing of projectiles to make everything smooth and pearls actually provide the reliability they should.
body: PearlFix is a Paper/Spigot plugin that improves projectile behavior by preserving player momentum after ender pearl teleports, correcting projectile accuracy, and making wind charges path better to collide with thrown ender pearls so pearl teleports trigger more reliably.
